description: Offline vehicle reported asleep: derived from vehicle_start_asleep (streaming enabled, suspend disabled) with the states swapped — the first fetch opens an offline row; the next probe returns asleep, which the offline clause routes to :start with a scheduled fetch and no row; only the following probe, served from :start, closes the offline row and opens the asleep row. The row appears at the terminal's first serve and the barrier's repeat proves it — no await. The asleep terminal repeats through the probe without writing.
